subject: Taxes
title: What Is Income Tax?
description: A short lesson to help you apply What Is Income Tax?.

hook.text: Income tax takes a percentage of what you earn. It's the government's largest revenue source.

buildup.text: When you receive a paycheck, income tax is already deducted.

discovery.text: Income tax funds roads, schools, the military, and social programs. Without it, modern government couldn't function.

twist.text: Many Americans pay more in payroll taxes (Social Security + Medicare) than in income tax.

climax.text: Income tax is both simple in concept—a share of your earnings—and endlessly complicated in execution.

punchline.text: A share of what you earn. Simple idea, complex reality.

quiz.question: What is the government's largest single revenue source?
